name: Buffalo Chicken Wings with Cheesy Potatoes, Veggie Sticks & Blue Cheese Dip (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat oven to 500°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional) and coat with a thin layer of oil.

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat. Transfer to one half of the baking sheet, spread out in an even layer, and drizzle with additional oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
1 tbsp cornstarch
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and add to the other half of the baking sheet, arranging in a single layer. Season with spices, then drizzle with additional oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
garlic powder
salt
black pepper
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb new potatoes
3 stick celery
½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Quarter new potatoes. Transfer to a baking dish, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add baking dish to the oven and roast until potatoes are starting to soften, about 15 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Place on a plate.
Trim and halve celery lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the plate with the carrot.
Trim cucumber, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sections. Halve each section lengthwise, then cut each half into ½-inch thick sticks. Add to the plate and set aside.

When the potatoes have started to soften, remove baking dish from oven. Stir potatoes, then spread back out in an even layer and sprinkle with cheese. Return baking dish to the oven and continue to roast until cheese is melted and potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, place yogurt, water, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a small bowl, then stir to combine the dip. Transfer half to another small bowl and set aside. Add blue cheese to the bowl with the remaining dip, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper
¼ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place hot sauce in a clean medium bowl.
When the chicken is done, add wings to the bowl with the hot sauce and toss to coat. Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide chicken thigh pieces, a ⅔-cup of cheesy potatoes, and a small selection of the veggie sticks between plates. Serve with plain dip. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide chicken wings between plates along with remaining cheesy potatoes and veggie sticks. Serve with blue cheese dip and enjoy!
